headerDisplay: Unofficial plugin. Your Somfy password is stored in plain text in Homebridge's config.json; protect that file accordingly.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the accessory shown in HomeKit.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your Somfy Protect account username (the e-mail used in the Somfy Protect app).

password.title: Password
password.description: Your Somfy Protect account password. Note: it is stored in plain text in config.json.

siteId.title: Site ID
siteId.description: Optional. If your Somfy account has several homes, set the 'Site ID' of the one to use. Available site IDs are listed in the plugin logs.
